headline: Executive order signed in December 2020 directing federal action on school choice, meaning options for families beyond their assigned public school.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to take steps to expand school choice. School choice generally means letting families use public support to pick schools or learning options other than their assigned public school. No summary was provided, so the specific actions, programs, and agencies involved are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order aims to widen the schooling options available to them, though the specific programs are not described in the source material.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle education-related programs
who_it_affects.how: They would likely be directed to act to support school choice, but the details are not given in the title.
